subject: Mutual Action Plan (MAP) - ZenWell / Redwood - draft and reforecast
messages:
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Stevens <rachel.stevens@zenwellhealth.com>
Cc: connor_obrien <connor@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Apr 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft + next steps (ZenWell / Redwood)

Hi Rachel — great to meet you and Tom today. Thanks for the time and for walking through your priority use cases for clinical triage and discharge summaries. Per our call, I’m attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestones, owners, and target dates. Key items below: 

- Target scope: deployment for triage summaries (Phase 1) + pilot for discharge summary generation (Phase 2).
- Initial target close date: 2026-05-30 (alignment on SOW + PO + security review).
- Milestones (high level):
  1) Security questionnaire + SOC2 evidence request — Owner: ZenWell (Priya) / Support: Redwood (Vivek) — Due: 2026-04-16
  2) Pilot environment access + model selection — Owner: Redwood (Connor) — Due: 2026-04-23
  3) Integration work (API keys, routing, KV caching) — Owner: ZenWell (Tom) / Redwood engineering — Due: 2026-05-10
  4) Pilot validation & quality signoff — Owner: ZenWell — Due: 2026-05-20
  5) Contract & PO finalization (SOW + terms) — Owner: ZenWell procurement / Redwood sales — Target close: 2026-05-30

Dependencies: SOC2 evidence, procurement PO approval, and access to sample notes for evaluation.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with row-level milestones) and a short SOW checklist.

Can you confirm owners/dates or flag anything that needs to move? Once I get your confirmation I’ll update the MAP and share the HubSpot link and DocuSign pre-fill for SOW.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
From: Rachel Stevens <rachel.stevens@zenwellhealth.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@zenwellhealth.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@zenwellhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft + next steps (ZenWell / Redwood)

Marissa — thanks for this and the clear MAP. A few items from our side after internal triage: 

- Appreciate the proposed timeline. We’re seeing competing priorities from an internal Q2 product release and our procurement cycle is slower than expected. We need to reprioritize a couple of milestones and push the target close date.

- Proposed changes: 
  * Move "Integration work" milestone to owner-driven sprint after our Q2 release — new due date: 2026-06-15
  * Pilot validation window: move to 2026-06-30
  * Contract/PO target close: move to 2026-07-15 (Medicaid billing cycle alignment)

- On the security questionnaire: Priya will still gather SOC2 artifacts but will need until 2026-04-20 to compile. We can still exchange sample notes next week.

We’re still very interested and want to keep momentum; this is primarily a date shuffle so you can keep the MAP but please update dates and call out any Redwood dependencies that become blockers with the new timeline.

Thanks —
Rachel
Director of Clinical Ops | ZenWell Health
rachel.stevens@zenwellhealth.com
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Stevens <rachel.stevens@zenwellhealth.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, connor_obrien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft + next steps (ZenWell / Redwood)

Thanks Rachel — totally understand and appreciate the honesty on timing. I’ve updated the MAP per your notes (see attached ZENWELL_MAP_v1.xlsx) and called out the few Redwood-managed dependencies that will shift if we move the integration milestone: 

- Redwood can provision pilot environment on our side by 2026-04-30, but the integration work that requires ZenWell dev time will need to align with your post-release sprint (new date 2026-06-15).
- Security: Vivek — can you confirm whether a late security artifact (SOC2 evidence by 2026-04-20) changes our compliance gating?
- Commercial: we’ll keep the SOW ready for DocuSign; Marissa to re-open HubSpot record and update close date to 2026-07-15 once we have confirmation.

Next steps (short):
1) Priya to share SOC2 evidence by 2026-04-20 (ZenWell).
2) ZenWell to provide sample notes for pilot by 2026-04-16.
3) Redwood (Connor) to stand up pilot env by 2026-04-30.
4) Marissa to update HubSpot & attach revised MAP + send DocuSign SOW link once PO cadence clarified.

If that all sounds right I’ll send an updated MAP and HubSpot/DocuSign links by end of day.

Marissa
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rachel Stevens <rachel.stevens@zenwellhealth.com>
Cc: connor_obrien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft + next steps (ZenWell / Redwood)

Hi all — quick note on security gating: a SOC2 artifact arriving 2026-04-20 is acceptable for an initial pilot (we’ll treat it as intake evidence and scope a security-side review for the production rollout). The only blocker will be if there are data residency or HSM requirements beyond what we discussed; if ZenWell expects HSM for keys we’ll need an extra 3 weeks for procurement/integration.

Otherwise, I’m aligned with the revised milestones and 2026-07-15 target close. I’ll update the MAP security row to reflect intake vs. production gating and add an HSM follow-up action.

Thanks —
Vivek Kulkarni
Sr. Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com
